blocks.text: Shark Pool
Be ready
for the big fish!
Take a tour of our incredible flagship display, the Shark Pool complex.
blocks.html: Take a tour of our incredible flagship display, the Shark Pool complex.

blocks.text: In this safe and close encounter, you'll come eye-to-eye with the predators of the Red Sea. Here, at touching distance, you can experience a heart-stopping and real-time introduction to sharks, sting-rays, manta rays, schools of fish and vibrant colonies of coral.
blocks.html: In this safe and close encounter, you'll come eye-to-eye with the predators of the Red Sea. Here, at touching distance, you can experience a heart-stopping and real-time introduction to sharks, sting-rays, manta rays, schools of fish and vibrant colonies of coral.

blocks.text: Featuring a huge shark pool, an interactive activity center and a transparent tunnel – the Shark Pool complex is an action-packed tour.
blocks.html: Featuring a huge shark pool, an interactive activity center and a transparent tunnel – the Shark Pool complex is an action-packed tour.

blocks.text: Do you dare to get up close to these notorious hunters as they swim above and around you?
blocks.html: Do you dare to get up close to these notorious hunters as they swim above and around you?

blocks.text: Did you know?
Most sharks can only breathe when they are swimming.
blocks.html: Most sharks can only breathe when they are swimming.

blocks.text: That means they have to swim constantly, even when asleep or they will drown!
blocks.html: That means they have to swim constantly, even when asleep or they will drown!

blocks.text: Zebra Shark
A rough skinned and spotted shark known for its long tail, which is half the length of its body!
blocks.html: A rough skinned and spotted shark known for its long tail, which is half the length of its body!

blocks.text: Zebra sharks are nocturnal and spend most of the day chilling out on the seabed or reef wall. This takes a dramatic turn at nighttime, when they become active hunters.
blocks.html: Zebra sharks are nocturnal and spend most of the day chilling out on the seabed or reef wall. This takes a dramatic turn at nighttime, when they become active hunters.

blocks.text: Though solitary during most of the year they form large groups in some seasons.
blocks.html: Though solitary during most of the year they form large groups in some seasons.

blocks.text: They are calm and non-aggressive in nature towards humans.
blocks.html: They are calm and non-aggressive in nature towards humans.

blocks.text: At our shark pool, you can meet our impressive female Zebra shark called Leah.
blocks.html: At our shark pool, you can meet our impressive female Zebra shark called Leah.

items: Habitat Found in shallow tropical waters in the Indo-Pacific Ocean and the Red Sea. Prefers to dwell on the sandy seabed under coral reefs
Size Average length 2.50 meters - can grow to 4.00 meters long
Weight Average weight up to 55 KG
Food Eats invertebrates on the seabed and small fish

blocks.text: Sting-rays
Sting-rays belong to a group of sea rays and are related distantly to sharks. They are cartilaginous fish ( they have a skeleton of cartilage).
blocks.html: Sting-rays belong to a group of sea rays and are related distantly to sharks. They are cartilaginous fish ( they have a skeleton of cartilage).

blocks.text: The sting-ray in our shark pool is called Amit. Amit is extremely friendly and has been a resident at the Underwater Observatory for several years. He loves to eat oysters and we handfeed him these, in order to maintain personal contact with him.
blocks.html: The sting-ray in our shark pool is called Amit. Amit is extremely friendly and has been a resident at the Underwater Observatory for several years. He loves to eat oysters and we handfeed him these, in order to maintain personal contact with him.

blocks.text: After feeding, Amit loves to be petted and rubs himself on the feeder's hands. Like other rays from the sting-ray family, Amit has a very long tail with two venomous spines.
blocks.html: After feeding, Amit loves to be petted and rubs himself on the feeder's hands. Like other rays from the sting-ray family, Amit has a very long tail with two venomous spines.

blocks.text: Sting-rays use these spines to temporarily paralyze and neutralize their attackers, for a few moments, giving them time to escape.
blocks.html: Sting-rays use these spines to temporarily paralyze and neutralize their attackers, for a few moments, giving them time to escape.

blocks.text: Sting-rays are not dangerous to humans and use their spines for protection only.
blocks.html: Sting-rays are not dangerous to humans and use their spines for protection only.

items: Habitat Found at the foot of reefs
Size Average Length 1.80 meters - can grow up to a maximum of 3.50 meters
Weight Average weight of 50 KG, can reach up to 180 KG
Food It feeds on various mollusks which it cracks with its special teeth

blocks.text: Hammerhead Shark
With their intimidating hammer shaped heads and eyes on either side, Hammerhead sharks can really get the blood pumping.
blocks.html: With their intimidating hammer shaped heads and eyes on either side, Hammerhead sharks can really get the blood pumping.

blocks.text: Like the eyes, its nostrils are also found at the ends of the ''hammer", whilst the eyes, placed on either side of its head, give this shark its'
blocks.html: Like the eyes, its nostrils are also found at the ends of the ''hammer", whilst the eyes, placed on either side of its head, give this shark its'

blocks.text: 360 ° panoramic vision.
blocks.html: 360 ° panoramic vision.

blocks.text: The structure, along with the habit of moving its head from side to side in a wide span when swimming, allows this shark to detect odors in a large area of water and hunt more effectively.
blocks.html: The structure, along with the habit of moving its head from side to side in a wide span when swimming, allows this shark to detect odors in a large area of water and hunt more effectively.

items: Habitat Found in shallow tropical waters at depths of between 3-25 meters
Size Between 3.60 and 4.30 meters There are 9 types of Hammerhead sharks - the smallest 90 cm long and the longest 6 meters long
Weight Average adult weight up to 150 KG
Food Eats invertebrates such as: squid, lobster, crab, shrimp, sting rays and even other sharks

blocks.text: Sandbar shark

The Sandbar shark is one of the biggest coastal sharks and is known for its high dorsal fin. It lives in sandy underwater areas at depths ranging from 5-300 meters and is unlikely to be spotted at the waters' surface.
blocks.html: The Sandbar shark is one of the biggest coastal sharks and is known for its high dorsal fin. It lives in sandy underwater areas at depths ranging from 5-300 meters and is unlikely to be spotted at the waters' surface.

blocks.text: Pregnancy is a bit on the long side for Sandbar sharks, gestation taking 12 months, after which they give birth to between 6-13 live pups.
blocks.html: Pregnancy is a bit on the long side for Sandbar sharks, gestation taking 12 months, after which they give birth to between 6-13 live pups.

blocks.text: It is believed that after the Suez Canal was excavated, these sharks migrated from the Mediterranean to the Red Sea.
blocks.html: It is believed that after the Suez Canal was excavated, these sharks migrated from the Mediterranean to the Red Sea.

blocks.text: Although not thought to be dangerous to humans, because of size and their closeness to reefs, it's better to keep a safe distance.
blocks.html: Although not thought to be dangerous to humans, because of size and their closeness to reefs, it's better to keep a safe distance.

items: Habitat Lives in the shallow waters of the Mediterranean Sea. This shark arrived in the Gulf of Eilat through the Suez Canal
Size Average Length 2.50 meters
Weight Average weight 50 KG
Food Eats fish and invertebrates found on or near the seabed and reefs

blocks.text: Blacktip Reef Sharks
Recognizable by the prominent black spots on the tips of its fins, the Blacktip Reef shark is common in the Red Sea.
blocks.html: Recognizable by the prominent black spots on the tips of its fins, the Blacktip Reef shark is common in the Red Sea.

blocks.text: These sharks, the athletes of the inshore, are fast and agile and are found in small schools that live on 'Coral Reef tables'.
blocks.html: These sharks, the athletes of the inshore, are fast and agile and are found in small schools that live on 'Coral Reef tables'.

blocks.text: Blacktip Reef Sharks reach sexual maturity at 4 years old for males, and 7 for females. Like the majority of sharks, they give birth to live sharks - instead of laying eggs.
blocks.html: Blacktip Reef Sharks reach sexual maturity at 4 years old for males, and 7 for females. Like the majority of sharks, they give birth to live sharks - instead of laying eggs.

blocks.text: These sharks are not known to be dangerous to humans.
blocks.html: These sharks are not known to be dangerous to humans.

items: Habitat Found in all subtropical waters at depths between 2-75 meters
Size Average length 1.50 meters
Weight Average adult weight is up to 15 KG
Food Eats mainly fish, crustaceans, squid and other molluscs

blocks.text: Bignose Shark
This is a deep-water shark, famous for its impressive and numerous large teeth!
blocks.html: This is a deep-water shark, famous for its impressive and numerous large teeth!

blocks.text: The lower jaw of a Bignose will across a lifetime, support 14-15 rows of teeth, and the upper jaw a remarkable 16 rows of teeth.
blocks.html: The lower jaw of a Bignose will across a lifetime, support 14-15 rows of teeth, and the upper jaw a remarkable 16 rows of teeth.

blocks.text: In that lifetime, which is an average of fifty years, Bignose sharks will only reach sexual maturity at 20 years old, almost halfway through.
blocks.html: In that lifetime, which is an average of fifty years, Bignose sharks will only reach sexual maturity at 20 years old, almost halfway through.

blocks.text: This shark is relatively rare, probably due to its secluded habitat, in the depths.
blocks.html: This shark is relatively rare, probably due to its secluded habitat, in the depths.

blocks.text: It may be dangerous to humans.
blocks.html: It may be dangerous to humans.

items: Habitat Commonly found in tropical and subtropical waters.
Size Average length 3.00 meters
Weight Average weight 60 KG
Food Eats fish and squid
